contract: A23-113 ①: Roblox friends never damage each other, on different sides and inside PvP areas: manual swings, Q / Z / X (line, chain, roar, hop wind; fields never hit players) and the kaiju's stomp (in every zone). PvPService asks Player:IsFriendsWith once per pair in the background when the second of the two is ready (join order free; 5 calls in a row, the next 5 one second later), pcall, a failed call = not friends, not friends until the answer; the answer is kept until one of them leaves (a rejoin asks again; a late answer after a leave is dropped). PvPService.AreFriends reads the cache only. CanAttack returns false, 'Friend' after Self / NotReady / Dead / Neutral / SameFaction and before the Halo-vs-Active-kaiju exception; CombatService.DamagePlayer is the last gate (a friend's hit = 0: no combat tag, no KO credit, no PlayerDamaged). KaijuService's stomp skips the kaiju's friends and its HP count does not count them. RankingService is unchanged (its own cache; a failed call counts as friends there, friend KOs score nothing).
limitations: The real IsFriendsWith web call, its timing and Roblox's own throttling are not run offline (the kit's Player double answers at once; a call in flight is simulated by a leave inside the double). A friend KO can still happen from hits that landed before the answer arrived (a few seconds after the second join); it stays off the boards as before. The client (aim hints, hit numbers) is unchanged.
